differences.native: MySQL maps the numeric month with MONTH, MOD, integer DIV, and ELT.
differences.app: SQLite extracts the month with strftime, casts it to an integer, and selects the same season with CASE membership tests.
differences.rationale: MySQL's ELT and DIV functions are unavailable in SQLite. Both expressions implement the identical December-through-February Winter mapping and leave the join, aggregation, ranking, tie-breakers, projection, and ordering unchanged.
